'''Prototype vibroblades''' were used by specially trained [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith commandos]] aboard [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's flagship|flagship]] during<ref name="Betrayal">"[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]"</ref> his [[Capture of Darth Revan|capture]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[3957 BBY]],<ref name="Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Later,<ref name="KOTOR" /> a [[Unidentified Sith commander (Endar Spire)|commander]]<ref name="Prima" /> serving in the [[Sith military (Jedi Civil War)|Sith military]] used a prototype [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] during the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' [[Orbit/Legends|above]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="Date2">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Revan, by then an [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] and possessing the memories of a [[Republic soldier]], during his escape from the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

The prototype [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroblade]] was a cheap [[Cortosis-weave]] [[Melee weapon/Legends|blade]], costing eighty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and made to be adaptable and upgradeable as [[Currency/Legends|funds]] became available to the user. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] was capable of withstanding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and could be upgraded with a [[vibration cell]], an [[Energy projector/Legends|energy projector]], and a coating of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Durasteel bonding|bonding alloy]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prototype vibroblade first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. The weapon is found on the remains of a Sith commander who is killed in an unavoidable encounter on the ''Endar Spire''. The commander by default uses a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], but if the player enters melee range, they will switch to the prototype vibroblade.<ref name="KOTOR" />
